# Support

## How to get help

- **Bugs** — open an issue using the bug report template.
- **Feature ideas** — open an issue using the feature request template.
- **Questions** — check existing issues first; if nothing fits, open a blank issue.

## Response time

This is maintained on a best-effort basis outside of paid work. There's no guaranteed response time.

## Funding support

If a project here is useful to you, see [`FUNDING.yml`](FUNDING.yml) for ways to support it.
